title: 2026 IS YOUR SEASON OF GOD'S FAVOR
text: I want you to do me a favor right now. Wherever you are listening to this, share this message. Share it with somebody. There are people in your circle. There are people in your network. There are people God has strategically positioned around your life who need to hear what the spirit of God is about to release. Don't keep it to yourself. The anointing that breaks the yoke is not for personal consumption alone. It [music] is for corporate transformation. Share this word. Share this prayer. share this prophetic declaration because 2026 is not just another year. It is your season of divine favor and somebody needs to step into this revelation with you. Can I have your attention in the realm of the spirit? I want to talk to you today from a dimension of prophetic insight and spiritual awakening. The Lord began to deal with me concerning this season. And I tell you with every fiber of prophetic authority resident in my spirit that 2026 is marked in the calendar of heaven as your season of uncommon favor. Not ordinary favor, uncommon favor. Not the kind of favor that makes sense to the natural mind, but the kind of favor that causes principalities to wander. The kind of favor that makes demons panic. The kind of favor that positions you in places where your credentials did not qualify you, but the hand of God distinguished you. Let me take you to the scripture. The Bible says in Psalm 5:12, "For thou Lord will bless the righteous, with favor will thou compass him as with a shield." I need you to see something in this text. The word compass means to surround completely, to encircle, to hedge about on every side. This is not favor that touches one area of your life and leaves another area baring. This is 360° favor. This is favor that surrounds your family, favor that surrounds your finances, favor that surrounds your health, favor that surrounds your ministry, favor that surrounds your business, favor that surrounds your career, favor that surrounds your relationships. It is comprehensive. It is total. It is absolute. Now I need to establish something foundational before we proceed. Favor is not luck. Favor is not coincidence. Favor is not random. Favor is a spiritual force. Favor is divine influence. Favor is heaven's response to covenant alignment. When God grants favor, he's literally causing men and systems and structures to work in your advantage without logical explanation. Favor makes you a candidate for miracles that you did not labor for. Favor opens doors that you did not knock on. Favor gives you access to rooms where your name was never mentioned. But suddenly, you are the topic of conversation. Look at Genesis chapter 39. The Bible introduces us to a young man named Joseph. Everywhere Joseph went, the text keeps repeating one phrase, and the Lord was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. But look at verse 21. But the Lord was with Joseph and showed him mercy and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison. Let me show you something powerful. Joseph was in prison, an environment designed for limitation, for containment, for punishment. But even in prison, favor found him. Even in a place that was supposed to restrict him, favor lifted him. This tells you that favor is not dependent on your location. Favor is dependent on divine selection. Some of you listening to me right now, [music] you have been in situations that look like prisons, financial prison, marital prison, career prison, health prison. You feel stuck. You feel confined. You feel limited. But I prophesy to you by the spirit of the living God. The same God who gave Joseph favor in prison is about to release favor [music] upon your life in the very place the enemy thought he had you caged. Where they thought they had you contained is where God is about to promote you. Where they thought they buried you is where God is about to bet your next level. Now there are dimensions of favor and I want you to understand this clearly because not all favor operates on the same level. There is general favor. This is the favor every believer walks in by virtue of being a child of God. Psalm 84:11 says, "For the Lord God is a son and shield. The Lord will give grace and glory. No good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly." This is baseline favor. This is the favor that gives you daily bread, that gives you protection, that gives you grace for your journey. But then there is strategic favor. This is the favor that positions you for assignments. This is the favor Nehemiah experienced when he stood before king at Xaxis. A slave asking a king for leave, for resources, for letters of protection, and the king granted it all. That was not general favor. That was strategic favor. Strategic favor aligns you with the right people at the right time for the right purpose. It is assignmentdriven favor. And then there is what I call explosive favor. The kind of favor that catapults you from obscurity to influence overnight. This is the favor Esther walked in. One day she's an orphan being raised by her cousin. The next thing she's queen of Persia. From the margins to the palace, from insignificance to influence, from having no voice to having the voice that will save an entire nation. That is explosive favor. And I decree that in 2026, [music] some of you are about to experience explosive favor that will shock your own family. Let me tell you why 2026 is prophetically significant. In the Hebrew calendar and in biblical numerology, the number 26 is deeply connected to [music] the name of God. The tetra grammaton y vav hair, the sacred name of Yahweh has a numerical value of 26. When you are walking in a season marked by 26, you are walking in a season where the name of the Lord is your strong tower. Where the identity of [music] God himself is backing your life, where you are not just carrying favor, you are carrying the very signature of heaven. There is something about the name of the Lord. Proverbs 18:10 says, "The name of the Lord is a strong tower. The righteous runth into it and is safe." In 2026, every attack fashioned against you shall crumble when it encounters the name that is attached to your life. Every conspiracy, every manipulation, every scheme, every plot, every trap, they will fail not because of your strategy, but because the name of Yahweh is a fortress around [music] your destiny. Now, let me show you something about favor and timing. Ecclesiastes 9:11 says, "The race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill, but time and chance happenth to them all." The King James uses the word chance, but in Hebrew it is pegg, which means divine encounter, appointed time, strategic moment. This scripture is telling you that there is a time and a season when favor locates you. Regardless of how fast you are running or how strong you are, some of you have been running. You have been grinding. You have been pushing. You have been walking yourself to exhaustion wondering why the breakthrough has not come. I want you to hear this clearly. It is not about the speed of your race. [music] It is about the set time of your favor. And I declare to you prophetically that 2026 is your set time. This is your PGA moment. This is your divine encounter season. This is when heaven and earth align to release what has been prepared for you before the foundation of the world. Look at the life of Abraham. Genesis 17:21 says, "But my covenant will I establish [music] with Isaac, which Sarah shall bear unto thee at this set time in the next year." Did you see that? At this set time, there are certain blessings, certain dimensions of favor, certain breakthroughs that are timecoded. They have a divinely appointed moment of release. You cannot rush them. You cannot manipulate them. You cannot force them. You can only position yourself in covenant and wait for the set time. And I am here to announce to you that your set time has arrived. Now, favor does not operate in a vacuum. Favor responds to certain spiritual dynamics. Let me give you keys that will activate and sustain favor in your life in 2026. The first key is the fear of the Lord. Psalm 103-17 says, "But the mercy of the Lord is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him and his righteousness unto children's children." The fear of the Lord is not being afraid of God. It is reverential awe. It is holy respect. It is the understanding that God is supreme and his ways are higher than your ways. When you fear the Lord, you qualify for mercy. And mercy and favor are twin sisters. Where mercy opens the door, favor walks you through. Where mercy forgives your past, favor secures your future. Where mercy cancels your debt, favor releases your inheritance. If you want to walk in sustained favor in 2026, cultivate the fear of the Lord. Let it not be religious routine, let it be genuine reverence. Honor his word. Honor his presence. Honor his instructions. Honor his boundaries. The second key is obedience. 1st Samuel 15:22 says, "Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams. Obedience is the currency of heaven. Obedience is what moves the hand of God. There are people who are praying for favor but refusing to obey the last instruction God gave them. You cannot negotiate with God. You cannot bargain with heaven. What God says you do not when you understand it, not when it is convenient, not when you feel like it. You do it because he said it. I have discovered that every new level of favor is preceded by a test of obedience. Before David killed Golth and became king, he obeyed his father and went to the battlefield with bread. It looked insignificant. It looked like a menial task. But that obedience positioned him for the encounter that changed his destiny forever. Your obedience in small things is positioning you for favor in big things. What God is asking you to do right now, do it. Stop analyzing it. Stop procrastinating. Stop waiting for perfect conditions. [music] Just obey. The third key is alignment. Amos 3:3 asks, "Can two work together except they be agreed?" Favor flows through relationships, through associations, [music] through alignments. If you are going to maximize your season of favor, you must be connected to the right people. You must be submitted to the right covering. You must be part of the right fellowship. Stop being a spiritual lone ranger. Stop isolating yourself. Stop despising structure and order. I have seen believers who are gifted, who are talented, who are anointed, but they are going nowhere because they refuse to align. They are always between churches, always between mentors, always finding fault, always complaining, always offended. Let me tell you something. Offense will block your favor. Pride will block your favor. Independence will block your favor. Find where God has planted you and take root. Honor the leadership God has set [music] over you. Submit to authority. Stop jumping from place to place looking for what validates your ego. Look for where God is validating your assignment. Let me take you to Luke chapter 2. The Bible talks about Jesus as a child and verse 52 says, "And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature and in favor with God and [music] man." I need you to catch this. Jesus increased in favor. This tells you that favor can grow. Favor can be developed. Favor can be multiplied. You don't have to stay at the level of favor you experienced last year. You can increase in favor. But notice the text says he increase in wisdom first, then in stature, then in favor with God and man. Wisdom is the principal thing. Proverbs 4:7 says, "Wisdom is the principal thing. Therefore, get wisdom, and with all thy getting, get understanding. When you grow in wisdom, you grow in favor. When you make wise decisions, when you speak with wisdom, when you handle situations with wisdom, you attract favor. Foolishness repels favor. Recklessness repels favor. Impulsivity repels favor. But wisdom, wisdom draws kings. Wisdom draws influencers. Wisdom draws opportunities. Wisdom [music] draws divine connections. Some of you need to ask God for wisdom in 2026. James 1:5 says, "If any of you lack wisdom, [music] let him ask of God that giveth to all men liberally and upgrade not, and it shall be given him." Don't just pray for favor and ignore wisdom. Pray for wisdom because wisdom will show you how to steward the favor. Wisdom will show you what doors to walk through and what door does to avoid. Wisdom will show you what relationships to nurture and what relationships to release. Wisdom will keep you from sabotaging the very favor God releases. Now, I want to deal with something that many believers struggle with, maintaining favor. Some people can attract favor, but they cannot maintain it. They have moments of breakthrough, but they cannot sustain it. They experience open doors, but they cannot walk through them with longevity. Why? because they violate principles. Let me give you principles that sustain favor. First principle, gratitude. An ungrateful heart repels favor. If you don't appreciate what God has done, he will not release what he wants to do. The lepers were 10, but only one came back to give thanks. And Jesus said to him, "Arise, go thy way. Thy faith hath made thee whole." The others were cleansed, but only the grateful one was made whole. Gratitude takes you from cleansing to [music] wholeness, from breakthrough to establishment, from favor to sustained favor. In 2026, cultivate a lifestyle of thanksgiving. Thank God for the small things. Thank God for what you used to pray for that you now take for granted. Let gratitude become your language. Second principle, integrity. Proverbs 11:3 says, "The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perversess of transgressors shall destroy them." Integrity is consistency between who you are in public and who you are in private. Integrity is doing what is right even when no one is watching. Integrity is keeping your word even when it cost you. Favor without integrity is dangerous. It will promote you into a position you don't have the character to sustain. And when you fall, the fall will be great. God is not just interested in opening doors for you. He's interested in keeping you in the room once the door opens. And what keeps you in the room is character. What keeps you in the room is integrity. What keeps you in the room is authenticity. Stop trying to impress people. Stop trying to project an image that is not real. Be genuine. Be authentic. Walk in integrity. And the favor of God will not only come upon your life, it will remain upon your [music] life. Third principle, generosity. Proverbs 11:25 says, "The liberal soul shall [music] be made fat, and he that waterth shall be watered also himself." There is a connection between generosity and favor. When you are generous, you create a flow. When you give, you open a channel for receiving. When you bless others, you position yourself to be blessed. Some of you are stingy and you wonder why favor is not flowing. You are tightfisted and you wonder why heaven is not opening. You cannot outlive God, but you can outsting yourself into limitation. In 2026, be intentional about generosity. Give to kingdom work. [music] Give to those in need. Give to your pastors. Give to missions. Give to the poor. Don't give from your surplus. Give from your seed. Don't give what is convenient. Give what is sacrificial. And watch what God will do. Watch how favor will begin to chase you. Watch how opportunities will begin to locate you. Watch how provision will begin to overflow in your life. Let me prophesy to you right now. I see people in this season who will receive job offers they did not apply for. I see contracts being handed to you that you did not beat for. I see checks coming into your account that you were not expecting. I see debts being cancelled that you thought would take years to pay off. I see properties being handed to you for fractions of their value. I see doors opening in nations where you have never set foot. I see favor from strangers that will make your family members question what happened to you. This is not by power. This is not by might. This is by the spirit of the Lord. This is favor. This is uncommon favor. This is favor that defies logic, that defies explanation, that defies natural progression. You are about to become a walking testimony of the goodness of God. People will look at your life and say something is different. Something has shifted. Something has changed. And you will tell them 2026 [music] is my season of favor. Now, let me pray with you. I want you to understand that prayer is not just about asking. Prayer is about aligning with heaven's agenda. Prayer is about enforcing what has already been decreed. Prayer is about releasing in the earth what has been established in the heavenlies. So as I pray, I want you to pray with me. Don't just listen, engage, open your mouth, speak into your life, declare into your destiny, prophesy into your future. Father, in the mighty name of Jesus, I come before your throne of grace with boldness. I thank you because you are a God of favor. You are a God who delights in the prosperity of your servants. You are a God who takes pleasure in seeing your children walk in abundance and overflow. And I thank you that 2026 has been marked in the archives of heaven as a year of uncommon favor for every son and daughter of the kingdom who is listening to my voice right now. Lord, I decree that by the authority of your word and by the power of [music] your spirit, every closed door that should be open is opening now. Every blocked opportunity is being released now. Every delayed miracle is being accelerated now. I decree that the season of waiting is over. The season of favor has come. I decree that what you have prepared for them from the foundation of the world is being released into the earth now. I speak to the heavens over their lives. And I command the windows of heaven to open to pour out blessings that there shall not be room enough to receive. I decree that every good and perfect gift is descending upon them now. I decree that divine helpers are being activated. I decree that strategic relationships are being formed. I decree that covenant connections are being established. I decree that favor is being released from the north, from the south, from the east, and from the west. Every power that has been assigned to block their favor, I command you to bow now in the name of Jesus. Every demonic conspiracy, every satanic manipulation, every witchcraft agenda that has been set against their advancement, I break it now by the blood of Jesus. I destroy every evil altar that has been raised against their destiny. I scatter every gathering of darkness that has been summoned to hinder their progress. I decree that no weapon formed against them shall prosper and every tongue that rises against them in judgment they shall condemn. Father, I pray for uncommon wisdom in 2026. Let them increase in wisdom. Let their understanding be enlightened. Let their discernment be sharpened. Let them make decisions that attract favor. Let them speak words that open doors. Let them walk in ways that position them for divine encounters. Let the spirit of wisdom and revelation rest upon them in the knowledge of you. I speak financial favor over their lives. I decree that their income is multiplying. I decree that their businesses are flourishing. I decree that their investments are yielding returns. I decree that their careers are advancing. I decree that opportunities for increase are being released. I decree that they are lenders and not borrowers. I decree that they are the head and not the tail. I decree that they are above only and not beneath. I speak favor in their relationships. I decree that divine marriages are being established. I decree that broken relationships are being restored. I decree that family members who have been far from God are being drawn back. I decree that children who have gone astray are coming home. I decree that unity is being released in their homes. I decree that love is being multiplied in their marriages. I decree that covenant friendships are being formed. I speak favor in their health. I decree that every sickness is leaving their bodies now. I decree that every disease is being uprooted. I decree that every infirmity is being destroyed. I decree that life is flowing through every cell, every tissue, every organ. I decree strength where there has been weakness. I decree healing where there has been pain. I decree restoration where there has been damage. The same spirit that raised Christ from the dead is quickening their mortal bodies. Now I speak favor in their ministries, in their assignments, in their callings. I decree that their influence is expanding. I decree that their platforms are growing. I decree that their voices are being heard. I decree that their messages are reaching the nations. I decree that souls are being won. I decree that lives are being transformed. I decree that the kingdom is advancing through their obedience. Father, I pray that they will not waste this season. I pray that they will recognize it. I pray that they will honor it. I pray that they will steward it well. Give them the grace to walk in humility, to walk in gratitude, to walk in integrity, to walk in generosity. Let them not become proud when favor comes. Let them not become careless when doors open. Let them remain rooted in you, grounded in your word, dependent on your spirit. I decree that 2026 is their year of acceleration. What should have taken 10 years is happening in one year. What should have taken 5 years is happening in 6 months. What should have taken months is happening in weeks. I decree divine speed. I decree supernatural acceleration. I decree that they are leaping from level to level, from glory to glory, from strength to strength, from faith to faith. I break every cause of stagnation over their lives. I destroy every spirit of limitation. I cancel every decree of the enemy that has said this is as far as you can go. I decree that there is no limit to what God can do through a yielded vessel. I decree that the best is yet to come. I decree that they have not seen anything yet. I decree that their latter days shall be greater than their former days. I speak protection over this favor. I decree that what God is releasing, the enemy cannot steal. I decree that what heaven is opening, hell cannot close. I decree that they are hidden in Christ. I decree that they are covered by the blood. I decree that they are surrounded by angels. I decree that no evil shall befall them, neither shall any plague come near their dwelling. I decree that in 2026 they are walking epistles read of all men. I decree that their lives are testimonies of the goodness of God. I decree that when people see them, they see Jesus. I decree that when people interact with them, they encounter the kingdom. I decree that they are salt. They are light. They are ambassadors. They are representatives of heaven on earth. Now, Father, seal this prayer with your spirit. Let it not be mere words. Let it be prophetic declaration that shifts atmospheres, that breaks chains, that opens portals, that releases angels, that activates destinies. I thank you because what has been prayed has been answered even now. I thank you because what has been decreed has been established even now. I thank you because your word does not return void. It accomplishes everything you sent it to do. We receive this by faith. We walk in it by faith. We live it by faith. And we give you all the glory, all the honor, all the praise in Jesus mighty name. Amen. And amen. Now, I want you to do something. I want you to open your mouth right where you are and begin to declare this favor over your own life. Stop being passive in prayer. Stop being passive in your declarations. You have been given authority. You have been given power. You have been given a voice. Use it. Decree a thing and it shall be established unto you. The Bible says in Job 22:28, "Thou shalt also decree a thing and it shall be established unto thee. And the light shall shine upon thy ways." Say this with me. 2026 is my season of uncommon favor. Favor surrounds me like a shield. Favor opens doors before me. Favor connects me with divine helpers. Favor distinguishes me in the marketplace. Favor establishes me in my assignments. Favor multiplies my resources. Favor expands my influence. Favor protects my destiny. I walk in favor. I live in favor. I breathe favor. Everywhere I go, favor goes before me. Everyone I meet is orchestrated by divine favor. Everything I touch prospers because of favor. Keep declaring it. Don't declare it once and go back to speaking doubt. Don't declare it this morning and by evening you are speaking fear. Be consistent in your declarations. Let your mouth align with what heaven has said. Let your words agree with the prophetic word that has been released over your life. Death and life are in the power of the tongue. Choose life. Choose blessing. Choose favor. I see some of you, you have been through a season of testing, a season of trials, a season that felt like wilderness. But I want you to know that the wilderness season was not punishment. It was preparation. God was not angry with you. He was developing you. He was building something in you that could not be built in the palace. [music] He was forming character in you that could only be formed in pressure. And now the wilderness season is over. The season of favor has come. You are coming out and you are coming out with spoils. You are coming out with testimonies. You are coming out with authority. You are coming out with anointing. This is your time. This is your moment. This is your season. Don't let anyone talk you out of it. Don't let circumstances intimidate you. Don't let delays discourage you. Stand firm in the prophetic word. Stand firm in the promise of God. Stand firm in the revelation of your season. You are not a victim. You are a victor. You are not a beggar. You are a child of the king. You are not at the mercy of systems. You are backed by heaven. Lift up your heads, oh ye gates, and be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors, and the king of glory shall come in. The doors that have been shut against you, I decree they are opening now. The gates that have been locked, I decree they are being lifted now. The portals that have been closed, I decree they are swinging wide open now. And the King of Glory, the Lord of Hosts, the Lord mighty in battle is entering into every area of your life with favor, with power, with breakthrough, with victory. Receive it, walk in it, live it, and in Jesus name, let this be your greatest year yet. Amen.
